verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Flutterwave serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.flutterwave.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs variant at /docs.md. The llms.txt content indexes product guides such as transfers, payment plans, subaccounts and virtual accounts, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these files successfully, and evidence of a fuller expanded variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or explicit agent-usage guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.flutterwave.com/llms.txt # Flutterwave Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://developer.flutterwave.com/docs.md # Flutterwave Documentation
Payment plans let you set up subscriptions for your customers on Flutterwave.
